subject: MAP: environment cutover & POC action compact — API keys, org setup, allowlist, VPC peering
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@helixcare.health>, Lydia Park <lydia@medsync.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Draft MAP and POC environment cutover checkpoints

Hi Sanjay / Lydia —

Thanks for taking time on the call last week. Attached is a short MAP draft (v0.3) and an IP allowlist template to accelerate the environment cutover for the POC. The items we need to lock in from HelixCare side before we can provision the POC are below — these are the minimal gating items to get a test run by Dec 8: 

- Org setup: confirmed org name and technical owner (we need a platform / admin account to add to the org)
- API keys: one restricted API key for the POC (read/write for generation; limited to test model) + note on rotation cadence
- Network allowlist: list of public egress IPs or CIDRs to whitelist (we provided a template)
- VPC peering: contact for peering, desired window (typical window: 2–4 hours) and preferred maintenance date

Target: cutover window week of Dec 6–10, with a hard POC demo currently planned for Dec 10 (internal stakeholders + product). If peering cannot be scheduled in time, we will fallback to a hosted path with a short-lived token for the demo — note in MAP under fallback options.

Action requested from HelixCare by EOD Tue Nov 30: confirm networking contact, provide allowlist CSV, and confirm the org admin email.

Attachments: MAP-HelixCare-v0.3.docx (draft), helixcare-allowlist-template.csv

Next steps (my side): Marissa will handle network coordination and Vanessa will own billing/entitlement items. I will create the MAP record in HubSpot (HS-1234567) and update the timelines.

Thanks —
Mateo Alvarez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
mateo@redwood.com
From: Lydia Park <lydia@medsync.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay@helixcare.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP and POC environment cutover checkpoints

Thanks Mateo — this looks straightforward. Quick answers: 

- Networking contact: please loop in platform+ops@helixcare.health (they own peering).
- Org admin: emily.patel@helixcare.health (we can add a HelixCare admin that you can invite).
- Allowlist: I'll attach the completed CSV by EOD Tue Nov 30.
- Peering window: we have an available maintenance slot Dec 7, 02:00–05:00 PT (preferred). If Redwood prefers a different block, say and we will try to shift.

Question for redwood: do you need a service account IP range (we can provide a /28) or should we allow only the VPC peer route? Also, for the POC do you require dedicated capacity or can we run on hosted with a pinned model for the demo?

Lydia
Head of Platform Partnerships
Lydia Park, MedSync (on behalf of HelixCare)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP — internal owners + network checklist

Looping internal owners: Mateo, assigning me to network coordination and Vanessa to entitlement/billing. A few internal action notes so we stay tight with the timeline: 

- Network: I'll take point with platform+ops@helixcare.health. We need the full CIDR list (prefer /29 or /28 if they can provide) and the BGP/cidr acceptance for peering. If they give us only a single public IP, we'll need to confirm NAT mapping.
- API keys: we should create a scoped API key in the MAP record labelled "HelixCare-POC-test" (expires in 30 days). Mateo — can you confirm the exact scopes we should set (generation, embeddings read)?
- Org setup: request invite to their admin org email (emily.patel@helixcare.health) and provision a sandbox org entry.
- Fallback: add explicit fallback path in MAP: hosted short-lived token with throttled concurrent requests (demo-friendly), and document any observable differences in latency.

Also: note that HLX-2026-0457 includes a one-time onboarding credit; we should keep finance looped if they request a custom SLA for POC (Vanessa). I created a HubSpot task (HS-1234567) and added the MAP draft to the record.

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

On Mon, Nov 30, 2026 at 08:15 AM Lydia Park <lydia@medsync.ai> wrote:
> Thanks Mateo — this looks straightforward...
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@helixcare.health>, Lydia Park <lydia@medsync.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 12:15:00 -0800
Subject: Finalized MAP actions and confirmed cutover window (Dec 7)

Hi all — thanks for the quick replies. Summary and agreed actions below (finalized in the MAP record HS-1234567):

1) Cutover window: Dec 7, 02:00–05:00 PT — HelixCare to confirm platform+ops presence for peering change.
2) Allowlist: HelixCare to send completed allowlist CSV to marissa@redwood.com by EOD Nov 30 (received; thank you, Lydia).
3) Org admin invite: HelixCare to invite emily.patel@helixcare.health — Mateo will accept and provision sandbox org entry.
4) API key: Redwood will generate a scoped key labelled "HelixCare-POC-test" (expires 30 days). Scopes: generation (default model), embeddings (read-only).
5) Fallback: If peering is delayed, Redwood will provide hosted short-lived token for demo and document limitations in MAP.

Attachments: MAP-HelixCare-v0.3.docx (updated per Lydia notes), helixcare-allowlist-template.csv (filled). Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMAP-HelixCare

Next steps (owners & deadlines):
- Marissa: validate IPs and finalize peering checklist (owner) — due Dec 3
- Vanessa: confirm billing/credit application and SLA notes — due Dec 4
- Mateo: provision org entry and create API key — due Dec 6
- HelixCare (platform+ops): complete peering on Dec 7 window and confirm end-to-end test — Dec 7

If anything changes on timing, please flag immediately so we can shift the demo. Otherwise we'll mark the MAP milestone as "cutover scheduled" and proceed to provisioning.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the demo.

Mateo Alvarez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
mateo@redwood.com
